title: Relevance of the Unrestricted Function
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $i$ be a coordinate. If there are two sign-cube assignments that differ only at $i$ and on which $f$ takes different values, then $f$, viewed as a real-valued function, has positive influence at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
Assignments witnessing that the function changes only at $i$
